meta_description: Guides for running your own VPN server with VpnHood! SERVER: install it on Linux or in Docker, managed or standalone, and keep its IP from being blocked.
title: VpnHood! SERVER documentation
lead: Run your own VPN server, in one of two ways. A managed server is run from VpnHood! MANAGER, the free web panel, which installs it and issues its access keys: its steps are in the VpnHood! MANAGER documentation. A standalone server runs on its own, from its own settings file, and these pages show how.
